decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanExisting Site PlanProposed Site PlanExisting Plans AR-1Existing Elevations AR-2Section A-A AR-3Proposed Plans AR-4Proposed Elevations AR-5Design and Access StatementFire Safety StatementFlood Map for PlanningReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The glazing serving the Proposed Right Elevation of the development indicated on drawing No AR-5 shall be fixed shut below 1.7m of the finished floor level and in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.
description: Rear dormer, front rooflights and extension to roof at side involving increase in roof ridge height.
